tasks.description: Implement the agreed routine soil check completion wire on b
constraints: Accepted base 34c8ae1. Return a valid unified Git patch in the JSON patch field, with exact source context. Controller owns writes and verification.

Exact wire: POST /commands, command_name=care.check_soil.complete, plant_id and operation_id in the established envelope. payload_json contains only rule_id (UUID), expected_care_revision (positive int32), due_local_date (YYYY-MM-DD), occurred_at (ISO 8601 instant) and timezone (IANA). Successful receipt: plant_id, rule_id, care_revision, occurrence_key, due_local_date, task_id, entry_id, state=completed, SQL watermark. Same owner and exact operation/body required on replay.

Connect the existing production owner /commands route to execute_routine_soil_check. Forward valid values, use owner from Auth and never accept guest or client-selected owner. Verify receipt plant, rule, revision and due match; non-empty exact occurrence key, UUIDs and valid timestamps. Preserve existing commands.

053 grants EXECUTE only to service_role. The preceding pgTAP fixture expects service_role denied at a 051/052 cutoff, so extend its permission assertion based on a clear private forward-migration feature marker (e.g. a COMMENT ON FUNCTION checked by obj_description), or adjust gate/fixture with the controller if needed. Keep anon/authenticated/PUBLIC denied in all modes.

Map expired/withdrawn/not eligible and outdated occurrence to bounded 409 conflict; wrong owner/plant 404, malformed input 400, expired/disabled account 403. Test routing and replay in actual Edge handler using synthetic RPC results only.
Do not deploy; no iOS, data publication, undo, reminder or scheduler change. Preserve all existing ownership and evidence checks.

acceptance_criteria.description: Owner protocol fixtures verify valid/malformed routing, blocked unauthorized calls and service-only execute.
